scope: Current pipeline and subtle loading/no-approved-badge UI at 5468b17 in Performance mode, measured before the subsequent image-status reload/cache/304 follow-up. These measurements do not establish low-power behavior of the final UI.
selection: All 16 planned completed trials: two before/after pairs per scenario, AB then BA ordering, 20 seconds each. No trials excluded.
aggregation: Median of each side's two per-trial measurements. Percent changes compare those medians. Ranges and individual values retained; descriptive evidence without statistical-significance claims.

browser.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

notes: Two paired repeats per scenario, with AB then BA order. Medians and observed ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Percent changes compare the displayed medians; individual paired changes are also included.
EventTiming null means missing reported slow-event evidence, not zero latency.
Next-frame timing uses requestAnimationFrame; it is not presentation latency or INP.
Current Performance-mode values cannot isolate UI effects from historical low-power results.
Whole-window ping statistics include the entire 20-second interaction window. Subsecond loads can occupy fewer than 5% of samples, so whole-window p95 may miss initial blocking.

Loading-phase ping metrics are unavailable: raw ping durations lack timestamps and ResourceTiming contains no /ping entries. Nulls do not mean zero latency or no requests. Full-window ping mean/max/p95 remain valid.
Ping measures fetch-to-response-headers latency; the response body is not consumed.

metric_definitions.ping: Elapsed time around await fetch(/ping): fetch-to-response-headers latency, without consuming the response body. p95, maximum and mean cover the entire 20-second interaction window.
metric_definitions.proxy_lag: Overshoot of a 10ms asyncio heartbeat after warmup; maximum and p95 are per-trial values.
metric_definitions.input_next_frame: CDP click event timestamp to the next requestAnimationFrame callback; not presentation latency or INP.
metric_definitions.loading_phase_ping: Unavailable: raw ping durations have no request timestamps and ResourceTiming contains no ping entries. No loading-phase metric is inferred.
